messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "serotonin syndrome can occur when taken alone"
set: ["serotonin syndrome can occur when taken alone", "serotonin syndrome is more likely when taken with other serotonergic medications", "combinations can increase risk of serotonin syndrome", "risk of serotonin syndrome", "conditions can occur without warning", "breathing problems may occur when first starting", "problems may occur when your dose is changed", "breathing problems may occur when dose is changed", "problems may occur when you first start taking tramadol", "others may occur", "benzodiazepine sedatives can be dangerous when used with tramadol", "other drugs can be dangerous when used with tramadol", "dangerous drug interaction could occur", "dangerous side effects could occur", "can cause bleeding in mother if taken within 1 week before childbirth", "can make it harder to tell when you have low blood sugar"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
